high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or dressing area. The individual is standing against a plain white wall with a door partially visible on the left side of the frame. The floor is tiled with light-colored tiles. The person is wearing a green button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, dark blue jeans, and white sneakers with beige laces. They have a watch on their left wrist and are holding a smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the photo. The person has short, styled hair that is slightly tousled.
